# ARC frame stencil

1. Identify solid rectangular outlines and any outline whose interior contains a non-background pattern; record each frame's color, bounds, and interior dimensions.
2. Treat the patterned frame as the stencil source. Leave it unchanged, and compare destinations by interior height and width; only exact dimension matches receive the stencil.
3. For each matching destination, preserve its outline and replace its interior with the source interior pattern, mapping source-frame-color cells to the destination outline color and preserving background cells. Keep all other background unchanged.
4. Erase each incomplete or dimension-mismatched frame in full when the demonstrations show those frames disappear. Verify by checking the output against a demo and confirming only eligible frame interiors changed and ineligible frames vanished.
5. Check dimensions and every row, then end with exactly one valid action JSON object on the last line."

3. Validate each rotated quadrant against at least one demo, especially with an asymmetric input; check dimensions are 2N×2N and the top-left exactly equals the input before submitting.
